# AptiQu frontend guidance

Follow the applicable [repository instructions](../AGENTS.md).
For tasks designing, creating, modifying or reviewing Flutter frontend UI,
read the relevant sections of [docs/FRONTEND_DESIGN_SYSTEM.md](../docs/FRONTEND_DESIGN_SYSTEM.md)
and inspect the actual theme/components and callers. The handbook is the single
frontend design reference; current user requirements and accessibility guide its use.
This frontend reading requirement does not apply to unrelated backend/content tasks.
